description: Source code for multiplayer lobby UI and game browser in Wesnoth project, including rendering, event handling, and sorting of game list.

classes.name: mp::gamebrowser
classes.description: UI component for browsing multiplayer games, rendering game items, handling events, and managing game list display.

classes.name: mp::lobby
classes.description: Manages the multiplayer lobby interface, including game list, user actions, and network data processing.

classes.name: mp::lobby_sorter
classes.description: Comparator for sorting game entries in the lobby based on map size and status.

methods.name: games_menu_heading
methods.description: Generates the header string for the games menu.

methods.name: gamebrowser::set_inner_location
methods.description: Sets the visible area of the game browser based on a rectangle.

methods.name: gamebrowser::scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the view to a specified position within the game list.

methods.name: gamebrowser::get_item_rect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area for a specific game item.

methods.name: gamebrowser::draw
methods.description: Renders the game browser UI component.

methods.name: gamebrowser::draw_contents
methods.description: Draws the list of game items or a message if no games are available.

methods.name: gamebrowser::draw_item
methods.description: Draws a single game item with icons, text, and selection highlight.

methods.name: gamebrowser::handle_event
methods.description: Handles user input events such as keyboard and mouse interactions.

methods.name: gamebrowser::set_game_items
methods.description: Populates the game list from configuration data.

methods.name: lobby::gamelist_updated
methods.description: Updates the game list UI based on current configuration.

methods.name: lobby::process_event
methods.description: Processes user actions like join, observe, create, or quit game.

methods.name: lobby::process_network_data
methods.description: Handles incoming network data related to the lobby.
